title: Pager maximum page count

scope.rationale: sqlite3PagerMaxPageCount is the Pager scalar boundary that replaces a positive maximum database page count, treats zero as a query, and always returns the effective value consumed by page acquisition and growth.

external_source_responsibilities: The caller validates a nonzero replacement against its operation-specific constraints
dependencies.caller_closure: The complete positive-update, query, state assertion, and return body is assigned. The production Pager growth path rejects pages above the stored maximum.

inputs: Live non-open Pager and unsigned requested maximum; zero means query
contracts.ownership: Scalar Pager state only; no allocation or borrowed data.
contracts.state_and_results: A nonzero request replaces maximum_pages exactly. A zero request preserves it. Both return maximum_pages.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Caller owns Pager synchronization. No callbacks or I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Infallible. A later page acquisition above the effective maximum returns FULL while preserving cache ownership.

representation_differences: The C API accepts Pgno and documents zero or negative query values, but Pgno is unsigned in the active profile; Zig exposes the exact active unsigned representation so zero is the only query sentinel.
Caller-side validation remains outside Pager, matching the source OP_MaxPgcnt ownership comment.

oracle.protocol: Open a Pager, query the initial maximum, replace it with positive values, interleave zero queries, and attempt page growth on both sides of the limit.
oracle.normalization: All page counts and result codes compare exactly.

assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O; caller owns Pager synchronization.
assurance.malformed_input: Zero is a valid query; positive values are stored exactly after caller validation.
assurance.continuation: Repeated updates and queries preserve a usable Pager; rejected later growth does not mutate the limit.

integration.production_owner: src/core/pager.zig Pager maximum_pages field and page acquisition guard
integration.native_call_path: Pager.maxPageCount replaces or queries maximum_pages; Pager.getPage returns FULL for new pages above that effective limit.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: The source-shaped state boundary now lives on the production Pager rather than only in the disconnected internal pager model.

independent_review.notes: Requires public OP_MaxPgcnt/pragma dispatch, scoped trace promotion, and independent review.

Capture a scoped durable update/query/growth receipt before internal-trace promotion.
